active_ingredient: INGREDIENTS ACTIVE Ferrum phosphoricum 6x, 12x, 30x INACTIVE 20% alcohol in purified water.
dosage_and_administration: SUGGESTED DOSAGE One dropper under tongue two times daily. Acute symptoms ½ dropper under tongue every 30 minutes for two hours.
warnings: Warnings Use only if cap seal is unbroken. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a healthcare professional before use. Keep this and all medication out of the reach of children.
